operations.title: The triangle-wall pole tower has a second injective one-plus-five grade and no nonzero scalar pole shift
operations.statement: At ambient degree 10 over F_32003, E2(K<=3) maps injectively to E2(K<=4) with dimensions 13 to 19, zero remainders, and an intrinsic new grade 1+5; a diagonal pole shift cannot intertwine both de Rham and principal relations at k=2,3.
